text:
oliver: Heads-up: after we upgraded the DAST engine this morning, the prod pipeline spiked with some auth-bypass alerts on the payment service. Filing here before I start triage.
nina: Saw that. A handful look like legit regressions, but ~60% look like false positives due to a change in the scanner's cookie handling. Can you paste an example?
dev-scan-bot: alert: [dast-prod] 2026-03-22T11:02:01Z id=scan-998 priority=high vuln=AuthBypass path=/v1/payments/test status=401->200
jordan: Example request/response attached below — scanner sends X-Scan-By: engine-v2 and the service treats it specially in staging only (dev-backdoor header). That header shouldn't exist in prod.
oliver: here's the snippet from the failing run:
```\nRequest: POST /v1/payments/test\nHeaders: Authorization: redacted, Cookie: session=eyJ..; X-Scan-By: engine-v2\nResponse: 200 OK (body contains test-token)\n```
lia: If the scanner is injecting X-Scan-By in prod runs that could be an onboarding/config mismatch. We have a policy that scanner headers can't alter auth surface. Who rolled the engine?
nina: I upgraded the scanner in infra yesterday (PR #4621). I scoped the deployment to both staging+prod to standardize results. I didn't realize the default header behavior would flip on some endpoints. Sorry.
sec-ops-bot: audit: infra.change by nina at 2026-03-21T22:44:12Z change_id=PR#4621 target=scan-engine config=header-inject=true envs=[staging,prod]
jordan: Two issues here: (1) DAST header causing FP/real auth bypass, (2) CI runner logs show KMS decrypt warnings when the DAST job tries to pull encrypted credentials for the payment test corpus. Different root causes but both surfaced after the upgrade.
oliver: Right. The KMS message was: 
```\nWARN: KMS access denied for role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/ci-dast-runner when decrypting /secrets/dast/payment-corpus\n```
lia: That hints at the repo's secret accessor role missing the new tag assertion requirement on our key. We recently tightened key policy to require principal tag `team:security-sdlc`.
sec-ops-bot: cloudtrail: PutRolePolicy event for role ci-dast-runner by nina at 2026-03-21T22:45:03Z
nina: Hmm, I didn't touch the role policy, just the scanner image. The role must have lost the tag during the deployment template change. I'll check the infra templates.
jordan: Quick triage proposal:
- revert header-inject change in prod scanner (stopgap) 
- run focused analysis to separate FPs vs actual auth regressions (security+app)
- audit CI role tags and add a preflight check to the DAST job that verifies KMS key principal conditions match assumed role tags
- update secure-review checklist to require header-behavior notes when upgrading scanner engines
lia: Also add an incident (SEC-INC-3124) to track KMS tag drift and scanner header regression. Include a timeline, who deployed, which runs produced FPs, and CloudTrail evidence.
oliver: I'll open the incident and drop links. Nina, please revert prod image and push a pinned version for staging-only testing.
nina: Reverting prod to engine-v1 now (rolling restart). Will leave a changelog comment in PR.
sec-ops-bot: action: incident SEC-INC-3124 created, owners=[oliver, nina, jordan], severity=medium
jordan: After revert, we'll rerun the failing scans and capture request/response diffs. If any endpoint still shows auth bypass after removing X-Scan-By, treat as high-priority vuln (possible app regression).
lia: For KMS, I'll open a separate task to reconcile key policies vs repo roles. Short-term: add a sentinel test in CI that does a KMS decrypt of a test blob before running DAST. Fail the job early and surface the missing tag.
oliver: Good. Also update the Security Review template: when changing scanner versions include: impact on request headers, cookie handling, and secret access patterns.
nina: Done: PR #4625 opened with revert + note. Leaving a follow-up PR to add the CI sentinel test.
jordan: Note for postmortem: root cause was a combination of scanner default header behavior change + role tag drift after infra template tweak. Remediation: revert, CI sentinel, runbook update, and enumerate KMS principals (avoid fragile tag-only authorization where possible).
sec-ops-bot: update: prod scans re-run at 2026-03-22T11:24:45Z status=partial-fail -> after revert status=green
lia: Closing loop: I'll add a runbook step to require CloudTrail evidence linking any role/tag mutation to an approved change request before marking incident resolved.
oliver: Thanks all. Quick wins: pinned scanner in prod, CI sentinel for KMS, runbook checklist update. Longer-term: consider mapping critical keys to explicit role ARNs instead of tag assertions. :white_check_mark:
__notes: Thread about DAST engine upgrade causing header-injected false positives and KMS decrypt/tag drift; triage actions and runbook updates. No title field per agents.md rules.
